The distillery

Generated by TestReport in pkg/distillery. Each block feeds generated traffic through the affinity still used by the tests and shows what it distills, next to the persona that actually produced the traffic. The taste is one Map across every category; similarities to personas are cosine, and the highlighted avatar is the reading. It is then read per category, in every category the shopper chose from — dresses, trousers, and the home category of its pick: the product the taste ranks first there, by the shop's own score — the taste seen through that category's weights — must be one the persona likes — within 80% of its favourite there. Shoppers do not always open their favourite, so the favourite is shown where they differ. Home decoration is reached only through the dimensions it shares with fashion, and through the shopper's home picks. Decay uses a one-week half-life at BaseTime, {{date .BaseTime}}; phases split below a similarity of {{score .Threshold}}.

Drift

Every ordered pair: the first three visits (up to two weeks ago, including a purchase) are one persona, the last four another. Summed flat, the old taste too often wins; decayed, the recent one should — as a persona, and in every category the recent half chose from. Phases should recover both, split where the taste changed.

Drawing off

Four of the drifts above, fed into two stills: one holds everything, the other has a standing draw-off, affinity.Rules.OlderThan(env.At, {{.DrawOffAge}} days), run after every feed against the time of the batch. By the end of the month the old taste has been drawn off: summed flat, the still that holds everything misreads some of them as the old shopper (red), the bounded one reads every one as the recent shopper, and only the recent phase is left.

Consent

The same detour, but Sofia's two visits were made without personalization consent. The consent cut drops them on the way in, so the still never sees them and Kate's month is one unbroken phase.
